segments.text: Two Claude Code sessions running simultaneously have no idea the other exists. Claude Piers MCP fixes that.
It's a local MCP server that acts as a broker between multiple Claude Code instances using a lightweight SQLite database to route messages between them
in real time. Your front-end agent can ask your backend agent what the JSON response type looks like for a new endpoint, and the answer lands directly
